note: A screen, not an audit: questions worth asking and the data needed to answer them. No savings are computed; typical benefits are the cited sources' general wording.

questions.question: Are critical steam traps monitored automatically?

where: site records: trap list with service
data_requests.how: Mark traps whose failure costs most.

questions.decision_rule: Monitor the most important traps online; survey the rest.

typical_benefit.wording: LBNL (as reported in LBNL-56183): "Automatic Steam Trap Monitoring 5%", 1 yr. DOE tip sheet: "Consider online monitoring of the most important steam traps".
source_titles: S19: Worrell & Galitsky, Energy Efficiency Improvement and Cost Saving Opportunities for Petroleum Refineries: An ENERGY STAR Guide (LBNL-56183, Feb 2005)
